Supreme Court of the United States 
No. 25A1448 
CATHERINE HERRIDGE 
        A p p l i c a n t 
v. 
YANPING CHEN, ET AL. 
O R D E R 
UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the 
applicant, 
IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of 
Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit, case No. 24-5050, is hereby 
stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court.  It is further 
ordered that a response to the application be filed on or before Wednesday, 
July 1, 2026, by 12 p.m. (EDT). 
/s/ John G. Roberts, Jr.     
C h i e f Justice of the United States 
Dated this 26th 
day of June 2026.
